ROC Curve Type

Source: R/type_roc.R
type_roc.Rd

Creates publication-ready ROC (Receiver Operating Characteristic) curves for classifier and biomarker evaluation. Curves are drawn with the AUC annotated directly in the legend, mirroring the style of cnsplots' rocplot(). Multiple predictors can be compared in a single panel.

Usage

type_roc(
  predictors = NULL,
  response = NULL,
  positive = NULL,
  auc_ci = FALSE,
  linewidth = 0.9,
  diagonal = TRUE,
  add_points = TRUE,
  point_size = 1.6,
  max_curves = 12,
  col = NULL
)

Arguments

predictors

Optional character vector of score-column names in data to compare. When supplied, one ROC curve is drawn per column. If NULL, a single curve is built from the formula variables (cliplot(outcome ~ score, ...)).

response

Optional name of the binary outcome column in data. Auto-detected when NULL (looks for outcome, response, class, label, status, disease, group, then the first binary column).

positive

Label of the positive class for factor responses. Defaults to the second level.

auc_ci

Add a bootstrap 95% CI to the AUC legend label (requires the pROC package; slower for large data).

linewidth

Line width of the ROC curves (default 0.9).

diagonal

Draw the chance diagonal (default TRUE).

add_points

Add threshold points when the sample size is small (default TRUE for n <= 200).

point_size

Size of threshold points (default 1.6).

max_curves

Maximum number of predictors to plot (default 12).

col

Color for a single ROC curve (default from clipar).

Value

A cliplot_type object for use with cliplot.

Details

Use the formula interface cliplot(outcome ~ score, data, type = "roc") for a single classifier, or pass a data frame with type_roc(predictors = c("marker_A", "marker_B")) to compare several biomarkers side by side. AUC values are computed with a dependency-free rank-based estimator; the optional 95% CI uses pROC.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Single classifier
cliplot(outcome ~ score, data = biomarker_df, type = "roc")

# Compare three biomarkers
cliplot(biomarker_df, type = type_roc(predictors = c("marker_A", "marker_B", "marker_C")))
} # }
